use_case: Controlled substance risk score (SYS-09): machine-learning score (0 to 100; Low, Elevated, High) with top contributing factors, shown on each incoming controlled substance prescription
vendor_or_model: PMS vendor (machine-learning model, feature of the vendor-hosted PMS; switched on by the May 2026 release)
data_categories: Patient age and sex; prescriber and pharmacy counts; morphine milligram equivalents; early refill history; payment type; patient-to-prescriber distance (ePHI)
human_in_the_loop: Pharmacist-only display; pharmacist reviews every controlled substance prescription, consults the PDMP, and documents reasons for any delay or refusal; the score never blocks a prescription
applicable_laws: 45 CFR 92.210 (Section 1557; age and sex are inputs); 21 CFR 1306.04(a) corresponding responsibility; Fla. Stat. 893.055(8) PDMP consultation; HIPAA Privacy and Security Rules (existing PMS BAA)

use_case: PMS drug utilization review (DUR) alerts: rule-based interaction, allergy, duplicate therapy, and age- and sex-based dosing and pregnancy alerts
vendor_or_model: PMS vendor rules engine with a licensed drug knowledge base (not machine learning)
human_in_the_loop: Pharmacist reviews and resolves each alert before verification
applicable_laws: 45 CFR 92.210 (patient care decision support tools include non-automated and automated tools used to support clinical decision-making, 45 CFR 92.4); inputs include age and sex
status: In production; review of age and sex inputs due 2026-11-30

use_case: Public generative AI chatbots used by staff to draft letters or answer questions
applicable_laws: HIPAA (no BAA, so entering PHI would be an impermissible disclosure)
status: Prohibited for any Restricted data (POL-04 4.6; POL-02 C.2)
